caseName: Fin. Oversight & Mgmt. Bd. for P.R. v. Aurelius Inv., LLC
caseNameFull: FINANCIAL OVERSIGHT AND MANAGEMENT BOARD FOR PUERTO RICO v. AURELIUS INVESTMENT, LLC

opinions.text: Upon consideration of the August 29, 2019 motion for divided argument, a total of 80 minutes is allotted for consolidated oral argument on both questions presented, and the time is divided as follows: 20 minutes to the Financial Oversight and Management Board, 20 minutes to the Solicitor General, 30 minutes to Aurelius Investment, LLC, et al., and 10 minutes to UTIER.
